value.rationale: Natural tunable Rydberg blockade family including friendship graphs; exact all-size zero-mode census is coupled to a genuinely dynamical effect where odd-size hub return uniformly tends to one but even-size return vanishes at explicit time of order \(m^{1/4}\). Thus the exact observable and its parity boundary yield a useful coherent transport test, not a renaming of known chiral bounds or arbitrary small exact numerics.
